# Phase 2 — analytical results (generated by `python -m calc.run_all`)

Mass properties: **pre-CAD estimate (calc/design.py EST)**. Every number below is produced by the code in `calc/`; equations are in each module's docstring, sources in `research/SOURCES.md`.

## 1. Ballistics (quadratic drag, `calc/ballistics.py`)

Release height 0.421 m (pivot 260.0 mm + arm 240.0 mm at alpha=138.0 deg), catch height 0.9 m, Cd=0.7, A=0.00763 m2.

| range m | launch angle | v0 m/s | catch speed m/s | peak height m | flight s | vacuum min catch speed m/s | min-catch-speed angle (drag) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 48 deg | 5.95 | 4.96 | 1.40 | 0.77 | 5.01 | 49.2 deg (4.96 m/s) |
| 4 | 48 deg | 6.75 | 5.82 | 1.68 | 0.90 | 5.90 | 47.9 deg (5.82 m/s) |
| 5 | 48 deg | 7.48 | 6.57 | 1.96 | 1.03 | 6.68 | 47.1 deg (6.56 m/s) |

**Target conflict (physics):** the lowest possible catch speed for a given range is the minimum-energy shot; in vacuum `v_c^2 = g(sqrt(R^2+dh^2) - dh)`. With dh = 0.48 m, catch speed <= 4 m/s is only reachable up to R = **2.06 m**. At 4 m the floor is 5.90 m/s (vacuum) / 5.82 m/s (with drag). No launcher can meet both 4 m and 4 m/s; we fly the minimum-catch-speed arc (48 deg detent is within 0.1 deg of optimum) — see DECISIONS.md D2.

3 x Gutekunst Z-141HI (R=1.2 N/mm, F0=14.5 N, Fn=166.7 N, sn=126.84 mm), drum r=30.0 mm, swing 90.0 deg, I_arm=0.0060 kg m2.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## 3. Cocking motor (`calc/motor.py`)

37GB555 12V 30:1 + Hall encoder: no-load 133.0 rpm, rated 0.98 N m @ 100.0 rpm, derived stall 3.95 N m / 5.3 A, R=2.27 ohm. Printed stage 16:80 = 5.0, eta=0.85.

| range | t_cock s | t_retract s | peak motor torque N m (% stall) | peak current A | peak ring torque N m | press->launch s | min fire->fire s | I_rms (8 s cycle) / rated |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 m | 1.07 | 0.64 | 2.20 (56%) | 3.05 | 9.3 | **1.91** | 2.59 | 0.83/1.5 = 0.56 |
| 4 m | 1.29 | 0.64 | 2.59 (65%) | 3.55 | 11.0 | **2.13** | 2.80 | 1.11/1.5 = 0.74 |
| 5 m | 1.63 | 0.64 | 2.99 (76%) | 4.06 | 12.7 | **2.47** | 3.14 | 1.49/1.5 = 0.99 |

Latency budget: button wake+TX 0.25s, radio 0.01s, cock, feed 0.45s, settle 0.05s, latch trip 0.08s (the ring returns to park during RESET, after the shot, so it is not in the latency path); the 1.5 s warning starts with the motor (cocking is fully enclosed) and FIRE is blocked until it has run >= 1.5 s.

## 4. Ring latch / servo trip (`calc/latch.py`)

Cocked torque at 5 m: 12.28 N m -> catch force 267 N on the 608 roller. Over-centre (toggle) latch on the cocking ring; steel nose dowel; servo MG996R.

| case | e mm (closing) | closing moment N m | finger force worst N | servo torque needed best/nom/worst N m | MG996R margin worst | (MG90S margin) | trip rotation deg |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| min_e | 1.0 | 0.267 | 8.8 | 0.092/0.112/0.132 | **7.0x** | 1.3x | 1.5 |
| nom | 1.5 | 0.400 | 11.0 | 0.125/0.145/0.165 | **5.6x** | 1.1x | 2.3 |
| max_e | 2.0 | 0.534 | 13.2 | 0.159/0.179/0.199 | **4.6x** | 0.9x | 3.1 |

Self-locking at e_min: **True** (holds with power off). The toggle cuts the force needed to release by 20x versus pulling a plain hook off the roller (267 N). An MG90S would not have a 2x margin, so the latch uses an MG996R; safety-pin shear if the servo is forced with the pin in: 13.2 N.

## 6. Button (`calc/button.py`)

| sleep consumer | uA |
|---|---|
| ESP32-C3 chip deep sleep (RTC timer off, GPIO wake) | 5.0 |
| ME6211 LDO quiescent (SuperMini) | 40.0 |
| TP4056+DW01A board, battery side (no USB) | 5.0 |
| Battery divider 2 x 1 MOhm | 2.0 |
| Switch pull-up 1 MOhm (open switch) | 0.0 |
| Haptic NPN / LED leakage | 0.2 |
| **total** | **52.2** |

Per press: 8.0 uAh; per day (5 presses): 1.293 mAh + self-discharge 0.822 mAh -> **6.2 months** on 500 mAh x 80% usable. SuperMini red power LED must be desoldered (it draws ~1 mA otherwise) [E2].

Cap springs: 4 x k=0.120 N/mm -> rest 0.72 N, actuation **4.42 N**, bottomed 5.14 N; solid length 4.0 mm < compressed 9.5 mm (no coil bind).
